description.narrative:
Overall objective of the project as formulated by IUCN ECARO (Eastern Europe and Central Asia Regional Office), is to demonstrate the value of Nature-based Solutions for climate change mitigation and adaptation in the Western Balkans.
More specifically, the project aims to:
- Strengthen knowledge and awareness on the role of Nature-based Solutions in climate change mitigation and adaptation;
- Enhance the role of Nature-based Solutions in the Green Agenda for the Western Balkans; and
- Catalyse opportunities for the deployment of Nature-based Solutions on the ground.
The main adjustments compared to the first phase of ADAPT include a clearly defined connection to the Action Plan of the Green Agenda for the Western Balkans (GAWB) and especially its biodiversity pillar, as well as narrative focus on climate change adaptation and mitigation instead of "mere" disaster risk reduction. The ambitious aim of ADAPT 2.0 is to, together with IUCN's other project financed by ADA (the Austrian Development cooperation Agency), significantly contribute to the improvement of knowledge, plans and capacities for protecting and preserving the critical ecosystems (with focus on forest landscapes) and biodiversity of the Western Balkans, while increasing climate resilience and adaptive capacity of the targeted population. EU approximation is a secondary objective that is however directly supported when steps towards the implementation of GAWB Action Plan are achieved.
ADAPT 2.0 is focused on ecosystem restoration, while the parallel ADA-financed project "Greening the Western Balkans" focuses on nature protection and biodiversity. Together these two projects aim to cover all the key actions in the GAWB biodiversity pillar, as well as a specific NbS-related action within the de-carbonisation pillar. The aim for Sida is to support a holistic approach to climate resilient ecosystem management with a strong donor coordination.

Insatsen är en fortsättning på ett tidigare partnerskap mellan IUCN ECARO och Sida, ett projekt kallat "ADAPT: Nature-based Solutions for Resilient Communities in the Western Balkans" (2019-2024). Det övergripande målet med projektet ADAPT 2.0 är att demonstrera värdet av naturbaserade lösningar för begränsning av och anpassning till klimatförändringar på västra Balkan, särskilt genom - Att stärka kunskapen och medvetenheten om den roll som naturbaserade lösningar spelar i klimatanpassning och utsläppsminskning; - Förstärkning av naturbaserade lösningars roll i den gröna agendan för västra Balkan; och - Katalysera möjligheter för utbyggnad av naturbaserade lösningar på marken.

The contribution is a continuation of an earlier partnership between IUCN ECARO and Sida, a project called "ADAPT: Nature-based Solutions for Resilient Communities in the Western Balkans" (2019-2024). The overall objective of the project is to demonstrate the value of Nature-based Solutions for climate change mitigation and adaptation in the Western Balkans, specifically by - Strengthening the knowledge and awareness of the role of Nature-based Solutions in climate change mitigation and adaptation; - Enhancing the role of Nature-based Solutions in the Green Agenda for the Western Balkans; and - Catalyzing opportunities for the deployment of Nature-based Solutions on the ground.
